# #714 — pr-body-gate never sets PR_HEAD_REF, so the validator's branch fallback is dead in the gh pr create path it was written for

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-10T02:53:17Z
Updated: 2026-08-10T02:53:17Z

---

## What happens

`.claude/hooks/pr-body-gate.ts` never sets `PR_HEAD_REF`, so
`scripts/validate-pr-body.ts`'s third resolution fallback — "the file may still
be committed on the branch being merged" — is **dead in the exact path it was
written for**.

The validator supports it (`scripts/validate-pr-body.ts:336`,
`headRef: process.env.PR_HEAD_REF?.trim() || undefined`), and its own comment
names the case: *"the `gh pr create` case the hook hits, where the lane has
pushed but no local checkout carries the file."* The hook sets `PR_BODY`,
`PR_TITLE`, and `PR_REPO_DIR` — but not `PR_HEAD_REF` (`pr-body-gate.ts:350-358`).

## Why the #709 fix does not cover this

#709 made the hook pass the payload's `cwd` as the tree under review, which
fixes the case where the agent's shell is IN the lane worktree. But the hook
reads `input.cwd` from the harness payload, which is the **session** cwd. An
agent whose tool layer resets cwd between calls (or which `cd`s inside the
command string) reports the PRIMARY checkout, sitting on the base branch, where
a lane's brand-new done-means check does not exist.

Measured on `lane/712-pre-push-writefailed`, body identical in all three runs:

```
# 1. from the lane worktree, direct  -> PASSES
$ PR_BODY=... bun scripts/validate-pr-body.ts
Done-means resolved in the tree under review:
  /Volumes/ThunderBolt/_tmp/open-brain/_worktrees/lane-712-pre-push-writefailed/scripts/done-means/712-pre-push-pipe-safe.sh
PR body validation passed.

# 2. through the hook at `gh pr create` -> REFUSED
BLOCKED by pr-body-gate: this PR body fails scripts/validate-pr-body.ts.
- Verification field 'Done-means' must name an existing repo-relative path;
  not found: scripts/done-means/712-pre-push-pipe-safe.sh
  (looked in: /Volumes/ThunderBolt/Development/open-brain)

# 3. from the PRIMARY, with the head ref supplied -> PASSES
$ PR_HEAD_REF=origin/lane/712-pre-push-writefailed bun scripts/validate-pr-body.ts
Done-means resolved in branch origin/lane/712-pre-push-writefailed
  (/Volumes/ThunderBolt/Development/open-brain), not on disk in any available tree
PR body validation passed.
```

Note the refusal text ends `(looked in: <primary>)` with no `; and in ref ...`
clause — the validator's own message proves no ref was ever offered.

## Why it matters

This is the #706 failure with one more layer: a valid PR is refused because the
gate asked the wrong tree, and every cheap way past is a false receipt — name a
different pre-existing check that never judged this lane, or claim
`not applicable`. That is the reflex ledger item 17 exists to prevent, and the
gate teaching it is worse than the gate not existing.

It also lands hardest on exactly the lanes that are doing the right thing: only
a lane that wrote its OWN done-means check (the RLVR requirement) can hit it.

## Suggested direction (not implemented here)

Have the hook derive the head ref and pass it, so the validator's existing
fallback is reachable:

- parse `--head` from the `gh pr create` argv when present;
- else `git -C <reviewRoot> symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD`;
- prefer the pushed `origin/<branch>` when it resolves, since the PR is created
  from the remote ref.

Keep the resolution ORDER unchanged (tree under review first, own tree, then
ref) — this only makes the third step reachable. The containment guard on
`existsInRef` is unchanged, so this widens WHERE a path may resolve, never WHAT
may be named.

A done-means clause should drive the REAL hook (the `gh pr create` shape) from a
cwd that is NOT the lane worktree, since that is the only shape that reproduces
it — `docs/lane-contract.md` round 28.
